description:
Open a trade suite: enables that trade's tools (they are hidden until opened) and returns its method and condition names. Open only the trade you are taking off; opening is idempotent and never closes anything. No arguments = the catalog. Suites:
- finishes (Div 09): flooring, base, transitions, wall finishes: core tools, no extra tools
- roofing (Div 07): sloped roof area and squares, true rake/hip/valley LF, drip edge, starter, ridge cap, underlayment
- siding (Div 07): net wall area and squares from elevations, opening trim, starter, corners, lap pieces
- soffit_fascia (Div 07): soffit SF from eave/rake LF × depth, fascia LF, wall receiver, attic intake vent area
- glazing (Div 08): storefront / curtain wall: frame SF, lites, glass SF, mullion LF, perimeter sealant
- doors (Div 08): doors per type and size from the door schedule, matched to tags on the plans: core tools
- plumbing (Div 22): fixture counts checked against the schedule QTY, pipe LF by system/size, hangers, fittings, insulation
- electrical (Div 26/27/28): legend devices and fixtures counted, conduit LF with drops, wire LF by conductors, boxes, whips
division opens every suite of a CSI division ("07" = roofing + siding + soffit_fascia).
name: open_suite

catalog.description: Every suite, one row each, when called without suite/division

opened.description: Suites opened by this call (empty when listing)

suites.description: Each opened suite's method and condition presets
